//: Two rules, both enforcing things DESIGN.md already states and nothing checked.
The Token Rule — 'a literal hex value in a stylesheet is a defect'. order-details.css held 26 of
them and passed every gate for months. src/styles/ is exempt because that is where a colour is
allowed to be a colour: the three theme files are the only place a token is assigned a value.
Logical properties — marketing.css had 16 physical direction declarations and auth.css 7, so the
two surfaces a visitor sees first were the two that did not mirror in Arabic. Every console
feature was already clean; this is what keeps it that way.
Only genuinely direction-dependent properties are listed. `width` and `height` read the same in
both directions, so banning them in favour of `inline-size`/`block-size` would have produced 180
findings that fix nothing — a rule that noisy gets switched off rather than obeyed.
